text:
Predicates:
LoanedOutTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
FootballPlayer(x) ::: x is a football player.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in year y.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
Club(y) ::: y is a football club.
KnownAs(x, y) ::: x is known as y.

Premises:
Ailton(Silva) ∧ BornIn(Silva, 1995) ∧ KnownAs(Silva, Ailton) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is known as Ailton.
FootballPlayer(Silva) ::: Ailton is a football player.
LoanedOutTo(Silva, Braga) ::: Ailton Silva was loaned out to Braga.
PlaysFor(Silva, Nautico) ::: Ailton Silva plays for Nautico.
Brazilian(Silva) ::: Ailton Silva is Brazilian.
Club(Nautico) ∧ Club(Braga) ::: Nautico and Braga are football clubs.
Club(Fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.

Conclusion:
¬LoanedOutTo(Silva, y) ::: Ailton was not loaned out to a football club.
